measurement: Donor, cell-source, clone, passage, tooth/root maturity, health, extraction indication, and manufacturing batch crosswalk
comparison: stratify or adjust; never pool unknown identities
failure_interpretation: Untraceable biological units prevent donor-level inference

measurement: Viability mapped by root-facing, ligament, and bone-facing compartment
biological_or_observation_unit: construct nested in donor and batch
failure_interpretation: Low survival or loss of compartment boundary

measurement: Continuous tissue contact at root-facing mineral interface; distinguish attachment from mere cell proximity
biological_or_observation_unit: section/field nested in construct and donor
failure_interpretation: Disconnected matrix or cell layer without organized fibers

measurement: Continuous tissue contact at bone-facing mineral interface
biological_or_observation_unit: section/field nested in construct and donor
failure_interpretation: No bone-facing attachment or a direct mineral bridge

measurement: Distribution of fiber/bundle angle relative to local surface normal at each interface
unit: angle in degrees and circular-distribution summary
biological_or_observation_unit: bundle nested in section, construct, donor
failure_interpretation: Parallel cell alignment without trans-interface bundles does not pass insertion gate

measurement: Histologic evidence of collagen bundles crossing and inserting into root-facing mineral boundary
unit: ordered categorical score plus fraction of evaluable interface
biological_or_observation_unit: section nested in construct and donor
failure_interpretation: Surface coverage without inserted fibers is not PDL attachment

measurement: Histologic evidence of collagen bundles crossing and inserting into bone-facing mineral boundary
unit: ordered categorical score plus fraction of evaluable interface
biological_or_observation_unit: section nested in construct and donor
failure_interpretation: Single-sided attachment or detached bundles fail

measurement: Width, continuity, and spatial variability of non-mineralized ligament compartment
biological_or_observation_unit: section nested in construct and donor
comparison: construct versus matched healthy reference where available
failure_interpretation: Collapse, excessive widening, or loss of continuity

measurement: Mineral signal within the ligament gap or continuous bridge between mineralized compartments
unit: fraction of ligament area plus bridge present/absent
biological_or_observation_unit: construct nested in donor and batch
comparison: biphasic versus homogeneous and bridge positive control
failure_interpretation: Any bridge is a safety/functional failure even if bulk stiffness rises

measurement: PDL fibroblast/progenitor identity and osteogenic drift assessed as separate panels
biological_or_observation_unit: cell preparation and construct nested in donor
comparison: input cells versus endpoint cells; PDL versus bone compartments
failure_interpretation: Loss of PDL-like state or inappropriate osteogenic conversion

measurement: Force-displacement, compliance, hysteresis/energy loss, stress relaxation when supported by fixture, and failure mode
biological_or_observation_unit: construct nested in donor/batch; repeated cycles are within-construct
comparison: matched ex-vivo reference under same geometry/fixture; fusion control
failure_interpretation: Very high stiffness with bone bridging is failure; unmatched force is uninterpretable

measurement: Mechanical and structural recovery after a prespecified cyclic loading block and unloading period
unit: change from pre-load baseline with time and interval
comparison: within-construct baseline and static matched control
failure_interpretation: Progressive drift, delamination, or incomplete recovery

measurement: Local inflammatory/stress response with compartment and cell source retained
comparison: cell-free material, uninjured construct, challenged construct if added later
failure_interpretation: Sustained inflammatory shift or donor-specific toxicity

measurement: Position and attachment after temporary support removal in a distinct orthotopic model
biological_or_observation_unit: animal/person as independent unit; teeth nested within subject
comparison: baseline and matched standard healing care
failure_interpretation: A construct assay cannot satisfy this; external holding force masks failure
